summary: AGS Insurance Group is an independent insurance brokerage in Sayreville, NJ (4000 Bordentown Ave, Suite 20), describing itself as operating since 2008 and licensed in multiple states. It concentrates on commercial trucking, commercial auto, restaurant/hospitality, medical malpractice and personal lines, and runs a separate transportation brand (dot-ins.com). Intake is phone-first with a small web quote form, an instant-quote calculator and a NEXT Insurance affiliate tool for restaurants, with a dedicated certificates mailbox suggesting heavy certificate-of-insurance and endorsement volume.

facts.fact: Headquartered at 4000 Bordentown Ave, Suite 20, Sayreville, NJ 08872; main phone (732) 832-7217.
Site states the brokerage has operated 'Since 2008' and shows a stat of 17 years in business.
Core commercial lines are commercial trucking, commercial auto, restaurant insurance, medical malpractice, cyber liability and personal insurance.
Older site copy lists licensing in 25 states (NJ, NY, PA, CT, MD, DE, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, TX, IL, IN, OH, MI, WI, MN, IA, MO, KS, NE, CO, AZ, NV, CA).

Homepage claims appointments with '15+ top carriers' (Progressive, Travelers, Hartford, Liberty Mutual, Nationwide, Chubb, Markel, Safeco, Foremost, Berkshire Guard, CNA), while the About page claims access to '150+ markets'.
Trucking page says the firm has a separate transportation division at dot-ins.com and describes the agency as 'family owned and operated'.
DOT INS (dot-ins.com) is branded as the freight/trucking insurance arm, also using phone 732-832-7217, and states it has been a licensed insurance provider since 2008.
The agency markets a dedicated Amazon delivery / Amazon Prime program covering GL, commercial auto, workers' comp and cargo requirements.
Restaurant quotes are routed to a NEXT Insurance instant-quote partner tool, with AGS retained as broker of record for renewals, COIs and claims.
The agency runs an SMS program (opt-in via web form or texting START to 732-832-7217) covering quotes, policy service, renewal/appointment reminders, claim updates and document requests.
Published contact email for certificates is cert@agsgrp.com (separate from info@agsinsurancegroup.com).
Progressive's agent listing shows office hours Mon-Fri 9:00-5:00, Saturday 10:00-12:00, no after-hours contact listed, and languages spoken English and Russian.

operations_signals: Primary conversion path is phone: quote CTAs are 'Speak to a licensed agent' tel: links, and copy says a licensed agent will contact the prospect within 1 business day (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
Web intake is a 4-step instant-quote calculator that returns an indicative premium range and requires a phone number, plus a standard contact form (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
Contact page form field is free-text 'Please tell us how we can help?' with no structured ACORD-style intake fields (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/contact/)
Published hours Mon-Fri 9:00AM-5:00PM with Saturday/Sunday 11:00AM-3:00PM on the older site; the refreshed site footer says Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM ET only (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/contact/)

Legacy contact page states office hours are 'by appointment only' and asks clients to call or email ahead; fax 732-210-0434 was listed (http://web.archive.org/web/2016id_/http://www.agsgrp.com/joom1/index.php/contact-us1)

Progressive agent profile lists no after-hours contact number and shows a shorter Saturday window than the agency's own site (https://www.progressiveagent.com/local-agent/new-jersey/sayreville/ags-group-llc/)
Amazon delivery page claims the team is available 'around the clock' for questions and claims guidance, which is broader than the 9-5 published hours (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/amazon-delivery/)
Dedicated certificates mailbox (cert@agsgrp.com) implies a standing queue of COI requests handled outside the general inbox (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
Restaurant page promises AGS handles 'renewals, certificates, and claims' for every policy, including NEXT-issued ones (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/restaurant-insurance/)
Service area is nationwide for commercial lines while the physical office is a single Sayreville suite (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/about-us/)
review_themes: No independent review corpus (Google/Yelp/BBB/Trustpilot) was retrievable during this run; all third-party review sites returned 403 or were unreachable, so no external themes can be reported (https://www.yelp.com/biz/ags-insurance-group-sayreville)

Self-published testimonials on the agency's own site are uniformly 5-star and emphasize speed and phone responsiveness, e.g. a trucking client citing a rebuilt program and 22% savings, and a restaurant owner saying they 'actually pick up the phone' (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)

Older version of the same site carried testimonials attributed to generic-sounding names such as 'John Smith, ABC Transportation', which are not linked to any review platform and appear to be marketing copy rather than verifiable reviews (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
tech_footprint: WordPress 5.6.23 on the legacy domain, with Contact Form 7 for web forms (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
HubSpot WordPress plugin v9.2.81 plus HubSpot tracking script (portal 3486962) installed, indicating a HubSpot CRM/marketing footprint (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
Help Scout Beacon widget (knowledge base / chat / 'send a message') embedded sitewide (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
Legacy Google Analytics Universal Analytics property UA-842683-9 hard-coded, with no visible GA4 tag (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)
NEXT Insurance affiliate instant-quote tool for restaurants, with AGS as broker of record (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/restaurant-insurance/)

Two live domains serving near-duplicate sites (agsgrp.com and agsinsurancegroup.com); homepage links point to the other domain and https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/get-a-quote/ returns 404 (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)

Refreshed pages exist on agsinsurancegroup.com with 2026 last-modified dates (Jan-Sep 2026), while the agsgrp.com WordPress install still serves the older theme (http://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml)

Industrial/real-estate page still contains leftover WordPress theme demo text and a placeholder testimonial and newsletter block, indicating an incomplete content migration (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/industrial-real-estate/)
No client portal, no published blog or resources library (only the default 'hello world' post), and a Facebook page that requires login to view (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)

Marketing claims are internally inconsistent across pages (15+ carriers vs 150+ markets; 25 states vs 'multiple states'), suggesting no single system of record for published content (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/about-us/)
growth_signals: Site relaunch in progress during 2026: new pages and SMS terms dated January-September 2026 alongside an older WordPress theme still live (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/sms-terms/)
Digital distribution partnership with NEXT Insurance to bind simple restaurant risks online while keeping AGS as broker of record (https://www.agsinsurancegroup.com/wp/restaurant-insurance/)
Dedicated Amazon delivery / Prime program page, indicating pursuit of gig-economy and last-mile delivery fleets (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/amazon-delivery/)
Separate transportation brand (DOT INS, dot-ins.com) with its own site and positioning as a freight/trucking specialist (https://www.dot-ins.com/)

Licensing footprint widened from a stated Tri-State focus (NJ/NY/PA) on the 2013-2016 site to 25 listed states and 'licensed nationwide' messaging today (http://web.archive.org/web/2016id_/http://www.agsgrp.com/joom1/)
Transportation arm self-reports 30% annual revenue growth over five years and a 99.9 retention rate, which is unaudited marketing copy (https://www.dot-ins.com/about/)

Adds adjacent niches beyond trucking and restaurants: medical malpractice sub-pages for OB/GYN, surgeons, physicians and dentists, plus cyber liability and industrial/real-estate property (https://www.agsgrp.com/wp/)

inferences.inference: Certificate and endorsement work is the heaviest recurring admin load in this agency.
inferences.reasoning: A separate cert@agsgrp.com mailbox, trucking/Amazon niches that generate FMCSA filings and per-vehicle COIs, and repeated copy about handling certificates and renewals all point to a high-volume, per-request document workflow.

inferences.inference: The operation looks small and owner-operated (roughly a handful of staff) rather than a multi-office regional agency.
inferences.reasoning: Single Sayreville suite address across every source, 'family owned and operated' language, 9-5 hours, and no careers page or job postings found anywhere on the site or sitemaps.

inferences.inference: Lead intake is bottlenecked by human callback rather than self-service.
inferences.reasoning: The instant-quote tool only returns a rough premium range and then promises an agent call within one business day; the contact form asks an open-ended 'how can we help' question with no structured risk data, so every new business quote requires manual triage and data entry.

inferences.inference: Marketing measurement has been blind for years, and the web stack is under-resourced.
inferences.reasoning: Only a Universal Analytics property (UA-842683-9, sunset in 2023) is installed, the WordPress core is 5.6.23, two domains serve duplicate content, internal links 404 across domains, and a live page still shows theme placeholder text.

inferences.inference: Published hours are unreliable, which likely produces missed-call and after-hours complaints.
inferences.reasoning: The agency's own site, its legacy site and its Progressive listing give three different Saturday schedules, and the Amazon delivery page promises around-the-clock availability against a 9-5 published window.
No review widget, review-platform link, or third-party review presence surfaced in the site HTML or anywhere reachable, while all testimonials appear only as hand-placed site copy.

inferences.inference: Growth is coming from digital/affiliate channels rather than additional offices.
inferences.reasoning: Recent work is concentrated on a NEXT Insurance affiliate tool, an SMS opt-in program and a site relaunch, with no new location, acquisition or hiring news found.

data_gaps: Hiring signals: no careers page exists on either domain and the sitemaps list none; Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor all returned 403 to this researcher, so no current or recent job postings could be verified.

Independent customer reviews: Google, Yelp, BBB, Trustpilot and YellowPages pages were all unreachable (403) or unavailable via search, so real review volume, ratings and complaint themes are unknown.

Decision-maker name and title: not published on the agency's own site or any company page that could be opened; business-registry and LinkedIn mirrors (Bizapedia, OpenCorporates, CorporationWiki, D&B, Buzzfile) were blocked, gated or did not resolve.
Headcount and revenue estimates: no source found; size can only be inferred from a single office address.

Web search infrastructure was unavailable throughout this run (search providers returned rate-limit and quota errors; Bing/DuckDuckGo/Mojeek/SearXNG returned bot blocks or irrelevant cached results), so news, awards and local coverage could not be checked.
The live site serves different HTML to a plain HTTP client than to a rendering client, so some copy (e.g. the '17 years' stat) reflects the rendered homepage rather than the raw markup.
